title: Exodus Movement, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Exodus Movement, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that on April 13, 2026, it filed a lawsuit in Delaware Court of Chancery against W3C Corp. and Seller Garth Howat to compel compliance with a Stock Purchase Agreement dated November 24, 2025. The acquisition targets include Monavate Holdings Ltd. (global payment solutions for fintech/Web3) and Baanx.com Ltd. (non-custodial cards and digital asset services).
key_points: The company entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement on November 24, 2025, to acquire W3C Corp. and its subsidiaries.
Acquisition targets include Monavate (global payment solutions for fintech/Web3) and Baanx (non-custodial cards and B2B2C digital asset services).
The company filed suit on April 13, 2026, seeking to compel the target and seller to close the transaction.
The dispute is being litigated in Delaware Court of Chancery.
This is a private company M&A dispute with no broader market implications.
